Personality: Maritzios, a prominent figure of the Kostobokoi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Maritzios owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Kostobokoi. Historical Record: Oroles is the head of the Kostobokoi, a Thracian house of the Getae. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
